queryTypes.description: Look up or search objects of one stereotype. A lookup finds one object by its identifier (has anchor). A search finds objects matching filters (has filters). Exactly one of anchor or filters must be present.

anchor.description: Lookup only. {"identifier": "<identifier exactly as the user typed it>"}, e.g. {"identifier": "SREQ 123"}.

columns.description: Attribute names the user asked to see, for a lookup or a search. Leave out when the user names no fields.

filters.description: Search only. List of {"attribute", "operator", "value"}. Leave attribute out of a CONTAINS_ANY or CONTAINS_ALL filter when the user names no field.

examples.question: Give me Data tag, data status for DATA-123
Give me the SREQs that contain 'Date of Birth' or 'Birth Date' or 'DOB'
Give me use cases whose comments contain 'DOB'
Give me the SREQs that mention both 'passport' and 'expiry'
Give me the pre-conditions of use cases that mention both 'name' and 'DOB'

queryTypes.description: List the business attributes (fields) available for a stereotype. Answered from metadata; no SQL is built.

examples.question: Give me column names of SREQ

queryTypes.description: Follow traceability links from one stereotype to another, e.g. the data used by a use case. Needs an anchor, filters, or both.

anchor.description: {"identifier": "<identifier exactly as the user typed it>", "on": "<stereotype code>"}. "on" is the stereotype the identifier belongs to: the source or the target. Leave "on" out when it is the source.

filters.description: List of {"on", "attribute", "operator", "value"}. "on" is the stereotype the filter applies to: the source, the target, or a stereotype between them on the route. Never put an identifier (e.g. SREQ-123) in a filter: it goes in anchor. Leave attribute out of a CONTAINS_ANY or CONTAINS_ALL filter when the user names no field.

columns.description: Attributes of the target the user asked to see. Leave out when the user names no fields.

via.description: List of stereotype codes. Fill ONLY if the question explicitly asks for the result to go through a specific stereotype. Otherwise leave it out.

examples.question: Which data elements are used by UC45?
Give me the use cases whose name contains 'tag' and the data associated to them
Which data elements are linked to UC45 through user steps that mention 'birth'?
Give me the status of the data used by UC45
Which data does UC45 use, via its steps?
